title: AgentSteer
description: Result of the agent.steer JSON-RPC method: the person's message was handed to the agent answering the run. The answer waits for the agent's own acceptance of the message, so a message the turn ended under is refused with an error rather than reported delivered. steer is a capability, not a promise: an agent whose protocol has no steering refuses the message and says so.

runId.description: The run that took the message.

steered.description: True because the agent accepted the message into the running turn.
